decision_conditions:
An application was submitted to the London Borough of Redbridge for the above property for consent to carry out the following works:
• T1 (Oak) - To crown reduce by 2m.

A 2m whole crown reduction would be detrimental to the tree’s health and longevity, and contributions to the visual amenity of the locality. A whole crown reduction is not commensurate to the lateral reduction of the crown on a single axis and would impact upon the tree’s health and longevity, and contributions to the visual amenity of the locality. A whole crown reduction on this basis is not necessary and is not the least amount of work required to remediate the issue. As a lesser course of action, that does not impact upon the trees wider health and longevity is available, the works requested are refused consent.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
